column1: respect of any year of assessment at the appropriate
rates specified in the Third Schedule to this Act:
Provided that the income tax payable for any year of
assessment by an individual who is deemed to be non-
resident under subsection (7) of section 79,  shall not be
more than the amount by which his assessable income for
that year of assessment exceeds the allowance referred to
in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) of section 33.
